blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle shakal pehchanein: \(\frac{x}{\sin^2 x}\) asal mein \(x \cdot \csc^2 x\) hai.
Yeh kitab ke Example 31 (\(\int \frac{x}{\cos^2 x}\,dx\)) ka jurwa (twin) sawal hai, bas \(\cos\) ki jagah \(\sin\).
First function \(x\), second function \(\csc^2 x\), kyunke \(\int \csc^2 x\,dx = -\cot x\) yaad hai.
Plan: parts, phir \(\int \cot x\,dx = \ln|\sin x|\) wala result.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x}{\sin^2 x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: pehle \(\int x\csc^2 x\,dx\) likhenge; phir parts, \(f(x) = x\) aur \(g(x) = \csc^2 x\).

Nayi shakal
\[\int \dfrac{x}{\sin^2 x}\,dx = \int x\csc^2 x\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\csc x = \frac{1}{\sin x}\), is liye \(\frac{1}{\sin^2 x} = \csc^2 x\). Is shakal mein second function pehchanna aasaan hai.

Parts lagayein
\[= x(-\cot x) - \int (-\cot x)\cdot 1\,dx\]
\[= -x\cot x + \int \dfrac{\cos x}{\sin x}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\cot x\) ka derivative \(-\csc^2 x\) hai, is liye \(\csc^2 x\) ka integral \(-\cot x\). Formula ke minus aur \(-\cot x\) ke minus se plus bana.
Dhyan dein: \(\int \csc^2 x\,dx\) ka minus sign aksar bhool jate hain; derivative se check kar lein.

Upar neeche ka derivative hai
\[= -x\cot x + \ln|\sin x| + c\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\) ka derivative \(\cos x\) hai, yani numerator denominator ka derivative hai; rule \(\int \frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}\,dx = \ln|f(x)| + c\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(-x\cot x + \ln|\sin x|)\]
\[= -\cot x + x\csc^2 x + \cot x\]
\[= x\csc^2 x\]
Kyun: \(-x\cot x\) par product rule se \(-\cot x + x\csc^2 x\), aur \(\ln|\sin x|\) ka derivative \(\cot x\). \(\cot x\) cancel ho gaya; integrand mil gaya.
